_comment: De-PII'd /v1/user/info for hermetic /billing/budgets. Synthetic team account: teams[] populated + teamId set => userSlice derives currentTeam (role=owner), so the page renders the real Budgets UI (table + Team Info + Refresh) instead of the 'Team Account Required' fallback (shown when currentTeam is null). The owner role is granted billing/budget permission by the test-env SSR role-permissions fetch (RSC boundary, cannot be mocked; see spec header). All identifying fields are synthetic placeholders — no real PII.
